verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web-search and extraction API that other agents call. Plugging external MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence only shows Tavily acting as an MCP server for other MCP clients, which is the opposite role and gives no credit toward an MCP-client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
